result: No remaining blocking issue found in this bounded pending-input/IME save-gate review.

findings.finding: Candidate transaction followed by view unmount removed the composition gate but left auto-save timers active.
findings.actualReproduction: Author reproduced candidate source write at 3000ms in r5, retained failure.
findings.resolution: inputInterrupted retains text/history, stops timers, gates save/checkpoint/close and blocks rescheduling after old acknowledgement; real edit/undo or new confirmed CJK composition may recover.

findings.finding: Explicit useDisk must clear interruption; compositionend tail needs continued protection.
findings.resolution: Confirmed install resets interruption and compositionChanged persists until final transaction or 550ms tail settle; author added useDisk/tail tests.

findings.finding: New confirmed CJK composition could remain locked if all docChanged transactions occur before compositionend.
findings.resolution: New composition compares final raw against captured compositionBase; commit releases interruption after settled end, cancellation/empty input does not.

verifiedInCode: domEventObservers runs pending markers ahead of CodeMirror built-in input handling without changing candidate text.
Normal synchronous docChanged clears short pending immediately; composing remains separate and never expires at 550ms.
save/checkpoint wait loops recheck after wakeup; inFlight save remains serialized.
View owners isolate cleanup; disposed view and buffer wake waiters unsuccessfully rather than leaving them suspended.
Old loadSequence/refreshAfterLoad H22 guard remains intact.
Dirty/history remain on the retained EditorState; confirmed disk replacement resets interruption.
